questions.question: Which ground hosted Fulham’s home Premier League matches during the 2002/03 season while Craven Cottage was being redeveloped?

questions.question: Which Premier League side conceded the fewest total goals during the 2018/19 campaign, letting in just 22 goals across 38 matches?
questions.explanation: Liverpool conceded just 22 goals in 2018/19 (one fewer than champions Manchester City), despite finishing second with 97 points.

questions.question: Which player holds the distinction of scoring a Premier League goal for four different London clubs: West Ham, Charlton, Chelsea, and Tottenham?
